name: jreb-pi-extensions
description: Custom pi extensions. Runtime has NO dependencies — pi loads the *.ts files directly. This package.json exists only for local dev tooling (typecheck); runtime resolution of @earendil-works/* is aliased by pi's extension loader to its own instance.

scripts.smoke: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-footer.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-telegram.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-progress.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-agents.mts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke-command.mts
